description: This Java class 'LogView' extends TextView and implements LogNode to display log messages received via the LogNode interface in an Android application. It formats log data and appends it to the view, with support for different log levels, exceptions, and log chaining.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView widget that displays log messages formatted via the LogNode interface, supporting log level indication, chaining, and thread-safe UI updates.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for LogView, initializing with context and optional attribute set and style.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log message with priority, tag, message, and exception, then appends it to the LogView and passes it to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Utility method to append a non-null string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends the log string as a new line in the LogView widget.
